b: Animation creates the illusion of movement by showing a sequence of still images quickly. Each image is a frame.
This works because of persistence of vision: the eye holds each image briefly, so the frames blend into motion.
Film is commonly shown at 24 frames per second. More frames per second give smoother motion.

q.q: Each still image in an animation is called a…
q.e: Frames shown in order create motion.

q.q: Why do fast-changing images look like movement?
q.e: The eye holds each image for a moment.

b: Traditional animation uses hand-drawn frames. 2D animation is made digitally with tools such as Adobe Animate, for cartoons, banners and 2D games.
3D animation uses modeled objects that are rigged and animated, for example in Blender. Stop motion photographs real objects moved a little between shots.
Motion graphics animates titles, logos and graphics, often in After Effects.

q.q: Which type photographs real objects moved a little between shots?
Which tool from your notes is for 3D modeling and animation?
q.e: Blender covers modeling, rigging, animation and rendering.

b: The 12 principles of animation include squash and stretch, anticipation, staging, follow through and overlapping action, slow in and slow out, arcs, secondary action, timing, exaggeration, solid drawing and appeal.
Anticipation is a small move before the main action, like a wind-up before a throw.
Slow in and slow out means movement eases at the start and end instead of moving at a constant speed.

q.q: A wind-up before a throw is an example of…
q.e: It prepares the viewer for the main action.

q.q: Slow in and slow out means…
o: Motion eases at the start and end

b: A basic workflow: idea, script, storyboard, design, animation, then render or export.
A keyframe marks an important pose or position. In-betweening, or tweening, fills the frames between keyframes.
Rigging builds a skeleton for a 3D character so it can be posed. Rendering produces the final images or video.

q.q: What fills the frames between keyframes?
q.e: Software or the animator creates the in-betweens.

o: Building a skeleton to pose a 3D character
q.e: The rig lets you pose and move the model.
